summary: Hunter Biden business associate and Rosemont Seneca Partners co-founder who testified that he co-created Skaneateles, held a 25 percent interest in it, shared a 10 percent BHR management-company stake with Hunter Biden, and transferred his side of that interest during the partners' business unwind.
title: Eric Schwerin
